SPECIFICATION FOR 
WAXED COTTON SELVEDGE TAPE 


|. Scope— Prescribes the requirements of grey, waxed, cotton selvedge tape used in electrical components 
of automobiles. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Shall be well and evenly woven from yarn having a count of IS texx2 (or 4Q s /2) in warp and 20 tex 
(or 30 s ) In weft. 

2.2 Selvedges shall be regular and firm. 

2.3 Shall be given a waxed finish using paraffin wax adding not less than 20 percent by weight. 

3. Requirements 

3.1 Tapes shall comply with the requirements specified in Table I.

3.2 Unless otherwise stated, S percent of the supply of tapes may be effected in a maximum of 2 length 
pieces. Each such length shall not be less than 5 m. 

4. Marking —Each roll of tape shall be attached with a label on which the following information shall be 
marked: 

a) Name of the material; 

b) Length and width of the tape; 

c) Manufacturer's name, initials or trade-market gwLn \ 

d) Year of manufacture. f \

5. Packing — As required by the buyer. ~ --- 

6. Sampling 

6.1 Lot —The quantity of tape delivered to one buyer against one despatch note shall constitute a lot.

6.2 The conformity of a lot to the requirements of this standard shall be determined on the basis of the 
tests carried out on the rolls of tape selected from the lot. 

6.3 Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller, the number of rolls to be selected at 
random from the lot shall be In accordance with col 2 of Table 2,

AMENDMENT NO. 1 JANUARY 1993 
TO 

IS 6673 : 1972 SPECIFICATION FOR WAXED COTTON 
SELVEDGE TAPE 

( Page 1, clause 23) — Substitute the following for the existing clause: 

‘2 3 Shall be given a wax finish using paraffin wax adding 2 ± 3 percent by 
weight.' 

( Page 1, Table 1, under Thickness , Max ) — Substitute ‘0.3 mm* for ‘micron 
30'. 

( Page 1, Table 1, under Thickness , Max, against ‘Method of Test 7 ) — 
Substitute ‘IS 7702 : 1975$’ for ‘$\ 

( Page 1, Table l, foot-note marked with mark ) — Substitute the following 

for the existing foot-note: 

*% Method for determination of thickness of woven and knitted fabrics.’
